conventions.keys: "@key" is an object of this plan that step 3 creates; replace it by the new id everywhere (attribute values, configurations' objectKey/templateKey, the invoice cases). Numbers are existing ids.
conventions.parent: path = object names from the organisation separated by " / "; key = object of this plan; id = existing object; parentOf = the parent of that existing object
conventions.attributes: unit = input/display unit of the attribute; value = one sample written at setup time; samples = samples with these time stamps (Europe/Berlin)
conventions.history: profile of org.jevis.jedemo.costs.History, written as samples of "Value" from 'from' to 'until' ("setup" = the time of step 3); afterwards the JEDemo job continues the rows
conventions.delete: objects go to the recycle bin, in this order and only after everything above was written; with checkFirst every check must pass: AFTER_CREATED (the objects of the keys exist), NO_CHILDREN, NOT_REFERENCED (no template, configuration or dashboard file of the organisation names the id), OLD_INVOICES (only invoices whose number matches numberPattern; the folder only if nothing else is in it)
conventions.fixes: changes of existing objects, skipped if the object no longer looks as described; REPLACE_HISTORY: all values of each raw row are deleted and the profile (seeded by the row id) is written from 'from' to 'until', unless the row already holds the profile at every quarter hour of the 'verify' windows; then the settings of the clean rows are checked and the values of the clean rows and of 'derived' are deleted (computed again)
conventions.settings: attribute 'value' entries of data rows (Data, Clean Data) are written at the configuration time stamp 1989-12-31T23:00:00Z like the Control Center does, so they hold for the whole history; other objects at setup time
conventions.setup: carried out by JEDemo: -sm single -jid <organisation id> -o costSetup=dryrun|apply (docs/DEMO-COSTS.md)
